acceptance: Recorded generation time and size at SF 10 and SF 100, or the largest practical scale with the reason.
If parallelised: a test shows identical output for one and several workers.
context: Filed 2026-11-12 from the scale-factor follow-up and TPC-DI generator work of 2026-11-11 and 2026-11-12: identified during that work and not addressed.
description:
## Problem
After BenchBox-dev/benchbox#4149 and #4171, FactCashBalances, FactHoldings, FactMarketHistory and FactWatches grow linearly (1,082,320 rows per SF together) and are written by single-threaded Python loops; only FactTrade has a parallel path, and that path now starts only above 100,000 trades, which is SF 0.77. Generation is measured at SF 1 only: 13.7 s and 76,020,843 bytes uncompressed. Two SF 10 attempts through `make heavy-run` on 2026-11-12 were stopped by the watchdog at host memory pressure level 4 caused by other sessions. About 140 s and 760 MB is a projection, and nothing is known above SF 10 although the command line accepts up to 100000.

## Change
Measure generation at SF 10 and SF 100 through `make heavy-run`. If the time is impractical, parallelise the four tables the way FactTrade is, keeping output identical for a given seed across worker counts.

## Guardrails
- Parallel output must be deterministic, as `tests/unit/core/tpcdi/test_deterministic_generation.py` requires for FactTrade.
- A change to generated bytes must change `benchbox/core/tpcdi/generator_specs.yaml` or the algorithm version so cached data regenerates.
